question: Does supplying lawful nearby trajectory families repair the current network's 100ms collision errors, compared with the same amount of augmentation around existing training families?
interpretation: A transductive diagnostic of coverage and local learnability. Evaluation centers are deliberately known when designing local support; this is NOT unseen-family generalization or faithful UNITAS reproduction.
base: local_collision_v1 inputs and fixed15000 short models; 206 original training episodes and47 reused validation episodes; test access forbidden

selection.validation_centers: all20 validation episodes with at least one eligible original pin-event
selection.training_centers: 20 of84 training collision episodes, ranked by SHA256('neighborhood-v1:'+str(seed)); do not rank by outcomes or model errors

simulation.perturbation: whole-rack initial translation along x or y, same legal reset, ball, robot and frozen action sequence; no query-time intervention
simulation.support_boundary: for each axis/magnitude use min(nominal,0.49*minimum distance of the original rack offset to either reset bound); both signs use the same magnitude
simulation.zero_controls: all40 centers must reproduce the entire native rollout bitwise with zero translation
simulation.physics: unchanged MuJoCo3.3.7, same benchmark source and timestep

windows.regular: 31 original regular query controls; preserve repeated query roles if a regular and event slot coincide
windows.event_slots: ten slots cycling through the sorted original event-query controls; thus every original event query is covered, duplicates are explicitly counted as sampling weights
windows.targets: original20 future frames retained only to compute unchanged full2s moving-pin groups; model supervises first100ms
windows.labels: all coordinates from the new simulator trajectory, never copied from an evaluation center
windows.input: same five point arrays and current R/world-linear/world-angular state15 as the previous short model; no center ID, perturbation, contact labels or query time forwarded

training.sampling: each minibatch has32 original base windows and32 augmentation slots, sampled uniformly with replacement; paired identical integer index traces; each augmentation pack has9840 slots
training.initialization: fresh identical short-model tensors per seed; original-base-only statistics copied identically to both variants
training.optimizer: unchanged AdamW lr1e-4, weight_decay0.01, betas0.9/0.999, eps1e-8, warmup500; FP32/noTF32
training.loss: unchanged equal-present ball/moving-pin/static-pin coordinate MSE with the full2s movement grouping
training.selection: fixed15000 only; no validation checkpoint selection; log every500 for diagnosis, no early stopping
training.compute: one admitted development GPU, sequential,6GiB allocator cap; CPU2-step andGPU100-step discarded preflights per variant

analysis.primary: same127 event pins and20 reused validation episodes; endpoints then pin-events then episode macro; pair seed-mean differences by episode
controls: original fixed15000 short scores, all3 seeds
nonparametric1-neighbor displacement transfer using input-only standardized distance, augmentation plus original training pool
analysis.retrieval_distance: equal average squared standardized difference for current scene63, scene history630, robot current60, robot history600, first plan60 and object_state165; mean/std from original training only, floor0.001 for every channel; same six blocks, no future labels in ranking
analysis.retrieval_displacement: evaluation current points plus donor's raw100ms future-minus-current displacement; diagnostic comparator only, never correction of neural predictions
secondary: each original event and every episode
quiet motion1/2/5mm on original regular queries
input proximity and neighbor future disagreement per nominal magnitude
analysis.interval: 10000 paired episode bootstrap draws,seed20261021; conditional on known evaluation centers and fixed seeds

decision.coverage_influence: validation-center beats train-center by at least30percent primary error, all3 seeds improve, paired95CI delta upper<0, and validation-center mean below10mm. This supports local coverage as a major limitation and rejects blanket inability of this recipe to learn nearby collision trajectories; no claim that architecture is globally adequate.
decision.learning_bottleneck: if validation-center1NN error<=5mm but validation-center neural error>=15mm, all3 seeds, despite augmentation event fit<=5mm, the available local examples admit a simple accurate predictor that this training recipe does not use; investigate representation/optimization rather than collecting indiscriminate data.
decision.inconclusive: if neither rule holds, inspect measured neighbor closeness, contact timing and error structure, then freeze a narrower follow-up. Do not report success solely from a lower error.

limitations: Coverage intervention adds both nearby collision geometry and the same shot/robot context; it cannot isolate which input block causes the improvement.
Privileged state is retained, so this does not establish sufficiency of21point-only histories.
Repeated slots and neighbors from the same source family are not independent episodes.
No autonomous long rollout or full paper model is tested.
Bootstrap excludes center selection, alternative hypotheses and repeated-use evaluation uncertainty.
